# RangeRow

```csharp
public readonly struct RangeRow
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

A row of a range read by [`CellRange.ReadRows<T>`](SharpCell.CellRange.md#readrows-func-rangerow-t): its cells by header or by column.
